current.text: He signed with Houston on a minimum contract this offseason.
The experts think he might be washed. One of them still sees him as an upgrade over Aaron Holiday.
Houston's guard rotation is crowded with Fred VanVleet, Amen Thompson, Marcus Smart and Reed Sheppard. He is part of a full bench with Smart, Sheppard and Steven Adams.
He will probably get the last rotation spot, so his minutes will be small.
Coach Ime Udoka is defense-first and plays his starters very heavy minutes. This leaves few minutes for a bench guard like him.
With our March 28 end date, Houston has a weak 3-3-4 fantasy playoff schedule, 10 games over three weeks.
Houston has only 14 back-to-backs this season.

note: Bogdanović should not be drafted in our league. Yahoo ranks him 408th and ESPN 277th, both sites value him at 0 USD, and only 144 players get drafted. He projects for about 18 minutes as Houston's last rotation player under a coach who gives his starters heavy minutes. His projections help only in FT% on tiny volume and in turnovers, and they are low in points, rebounds, steals and blocks. Watch him on waivers only if Houston's guards get hurt early in the season.
